items.scope: All Vaadin products and supported open source projects hosted at https://github.com/vaadin.
NVIDIA issues only.
Vulnerabilities in any Google Cloud developed product and not under the scope of another CNA.
Projects within The Document Foundation only, e.g., LibreOffice, LibreOffice Online; The Document Foundation discourages reporting denial of service bugs as security issues.
All Cloudflare products, projects hosted at https://github.com/cloudflare/, and any vulnerabilities discovered by Cloudflare that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities in vendor products discovered by BLSOPS, or related parties, while performing vulnerability research or security assessments, unless covered by another CNA’s scope.
Microchip Technology products only.
All dotCMS product services including the vulnerabilities reported in our open source core located at https://github.com/dotCMS/core.
All Acronis products, including Acronis Cyber Protect, Acronis Cyber Protect Home Office, Acronis DeviceLock DLP, and Acronis Snap Deploy.
All ONEKEY products and vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by ONEKEY that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Software vulnerabilities related to the TianoCore Open Source.
Vulnerability assignment related to its vulnerability coordination role.
SolarWinds products only.

Root Scope: Organizations that are cooperative partners of CERT@VDE.
CNA Scope: Products of CERT@VDE cooperative partners and brands listed at https://cert.vde.com/en/cna/. Also, industrial and infrastructure control systems (and its components) of European Union (EU) based vendors unless covered by the scope of another CNA. Partners and brands include but are not limited to: ADS-TEC Industrial IT, Auma, sipos, Beckhoff, Bender, Bucher Automation, CLAAS, 365FarmNet, Satinfo, Carlo Gavazzi Controls, Codesys, DURAG GROUP, Draeger, Endress+Hauser, Euchner, Festo Didactic, Festo, Frauscher, GEA, HIMA, Harman, Helmholz, Hilscher, K4 DIGITAL, KEB, Krohne, Kuka, Lenze, BHN Services, MB connect line, Miele, Murrelektronik, PHOENIX CONTACT, Etherwan Systems, Innominate, Pepperl+Fuchs, Pilz, SMA, SWARCO, Trumpf, TRUMPF Laser, TRUMPF Werkzeugmaschinen, VARTA Storage, VEGA, WAGO, M&M Software, Weidmueller, Welotec, Wiesemann & Theis, ifm.
All Ribose products and services, including open source projects, supported products, and end-of-life/end-of-service products.
Bosch products only.
Hanwha Vision (formerly Samsung Techwin and Hanwha Techwin) products and solutions only, including end-of-life (EOL).
N-able branded products and technologies only.
Kubernetes issues only.
All NLnet Labs projects.
Intel branded products and technologies and Intel managed open source projects.

Siemens issues only.

Supermicro branded products, managed system, or software projects.
All HashiCorp products and projects unless covered by another CNA’s scope.

Hitachi products excluding Hitachi Energy and Hitachi Vantara products.
Dragos products and third-party products it researches related to operational technology (OT)/industrial control systems (ICS) not covered by another CNA.
Vulnerabilities identified in Wiz products, and vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, Wiz that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities in software discovered by NCSC-FI, and vulnerabilities reported to NCSC-FI for coordinated disclosure, which are not in another CNA’s scope.
SoftIron HyperCloud branded products and technologies only.
Citrix issues only.

All Cisco products, and any third-party research targets that are not in another CNA’s scope. Cisco will not issue a CVE ID for issues reported on products that are past the Last Day of Support milestone, as defined on Cisco’s End-of-Life Policy, which is available at https://www.cisco.com/c/en/us/products/eos-eol-policy.html.
Qualcomm and Snapdragon issues only.
Juniper issues only.
Switzerland Government Common Vulnerability Program.
All HCL products only.
Vulnerabilities in software discovered by DIVD, and vulnerabilities reported to DIVD for coordinated disclosure, which are not in another CNA’s scope.
Azure Access branded products and technologies only.
Zabbix products and Zabbix projects listed on https://git.zabbix.com/ only.

Any code repository hosted under gerrit.wikimedia.org, gitlab.wikimedia.org, or github.com/wikimedia that is not labeled as archived or marked as a fork of an upstream project. Please see our disclosure policy for additional exclusions to scope.
WSO2 products and services scoped under Responsible Disclosure Program https://security.docs.wso2.com/en/latest/security-reporting/reward-and-acknowledgement-program/#products-services-in-scope.
